name: vorlyn-sync
description: Closes both halves of the Vorlyn review loop for a repo's markdown specs, PRDs, plans and ADRs. The vorlyn-sync skill (plus an opt-in Stop hook and a link command) pushes artifacts into Vorlyn with a change note a human reviewer can actually read; the vorlyn-review skill pulls the resulting feedback back over the Vorlyn MCP tools — comments, suggested edits, sign-off — and turns it into a revision.
